display.purpose: The one headline on a page. Never above 32px.

title.purpose: Card headings, table captions, button labels.

body.purpose: All prose and UI text. 13px base, 68ch measure.

label.purpose: Field labels, table headers, metadata. Sentence case.

data.purpose: Every number, ID, IP, port, timestamp and connect string. Always tabular.

shadows.name: surface
shadows.purpose: Panels, cards, table containers and the nav. A shallow contact shadow plus a 1px lit top edge.

shadows.name: recess
shadows.purpose: Inputs, wells, connect boxes and meter tracks — the light cue inverted for recessed surfaces.

shadows.name: control
shadows.purpose: Buttons, so they read as pressable rather than painted on.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Dropdowns, popovers and dialogs — the only genuinely floating UI.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Button and row hover: background and border only.

motion.name: control
motion.purpose: Inputs, checkboxes and dropzones changing border or background.

motion.name: disclosure
motion.purpose: Mobile nav collapse. Drives height because Bootstrap collapse writes a pixel height; the only layout-property transition in the system.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single primary action in a region. Flat amber fill, never a gradient.

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Neutral, so it never competes with the primary action for the accent.

components.name: Panel
components.description: Flat surface on the canvas. Never nested, never shadowed.

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Recessed well with a visible rule; focus is an outline, never a colour halo.

components.name: Data Table
components.description: The primary content form. Numerics are tabular and right-aligned.
components.css: .ds-table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:.8125rem;color:var(--color-ink,#e6e9ec)}.ds-table thead th{text-align:left;color:var(--color-faint,#7b848d);font-weight:600;padding:.6rem .85rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--color-line,#2a2f34)}.ds-table tbody td{padding:.6rem .85rem;border-top:1px solid var(--color-line-soft,#21262a)}.ds-table tbody tr:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.045)}.ds-table .num{font-family:"JetBrains Mono",ui-monospace,monospace;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:var(--color-muted,#a0a8b0)}

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Capsule chip carrying a semantic state. Pill radius is reserved for these.

components.name: Goal Meter
components.description: Funding meter. The track carries its own value step so an empty meter still reads as a control; the fill saturates at 100% while the label reports the true figure.

narrative.overview: serveme.tf v2 plays its category straight. There is no thematic world, no metaphor, and no irony: this is a conventional dark operator UI, and every point of quality comes from execution precision and product specificity rather than from a distinctive aesthetic. The named craft bar is Linear and the Stripe Dashboard. The audience arrives mid-Discord-call with eleven people waiting, so density is a feature and no decoration may cost a booking click. The explicit anti-reference is the first v2 generation, which failed by being a low-fidelity imitation of this same canon.
keyCharacteristics: Depth is value steps, a 1px lit top edge, and a shallow contact shadow — never a glow.
One accent, one job: the primary action.
Numbers are monospaced and tabular everywhere, without exception.
Structure comes from visible 1px rules and full-width bands, not floating cards.
13px is the base size; large type is rare and deliberate.

rules.name: The One Job Rule
rules.body: Signal Amber marks the primary action and nothing else. If two amber things are visible in one viewport, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The State-Colour Rule
rules.body: Green, red, blue, caution and gold carry meaning, never mood.

rules.name: The Structural Depth Rule
rules.body: Depth is neutral value steps and 1px rules. Glows and accent-tinted background gradients are prohibited.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Any digit a user might compare against another digit is set in JetBrains Mono with tabular-nums.

rules.name: The Small-Type Rule
rules.body: 13px is the base. Large type only when a number or headline is genuinely the most important object on screen.

rules.name: The No-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: No tracked uppercase kicker above section headings.

rules.name: The No-Halo Rule
rules.body: A zero-offset coloured glow is never depth.

rules.name: The Visible Track Rule
rules.body: Any meter or track carries its own value step plus a 1px rule, so a zero-value meter still reads as a control.

rules.name: The Plane Rule
rules.body: A page may establish at most one full-bleed plane above the canvas. Bands do not each get their own tint.

dos: Do set every comparable number in JetBrains Mono with tabular figures.
Do build page structure from full-width bands divided by 1px rules.
Do keep one primary action per region, in Signal Amber, as a flat fill.
Do show both capacity tiers in the status readout, as v1 did.
Do state real numbers with their units and totals, never a bare figure.
Do keep the base size at 13px and let density be the point.
donts: Don't reintroduce the radial accent glow, gradient button fills, or 16px card radii.
Don't use Signal Amber for links, headline highlights, progress fills, or body emphasis.
Don't nest panels, or place a coloured border wider than 1px on any container.
Don't let a marketing headline outweigh the live data it is meant to support.
Don't collapse a multi-tier fact into one number because it fits the layout better.
Don't add a font, an icon set, or a decorative device to solve a problem that hierarchy would solve.
